verdict.rationale: telli documents a REST API with API-key bearer authentication and a published OpenAPI spec, so contacts and calls can be managed programmatically without the UI, which supports headless automation. Scheduled workflow triggers add in-platform recurring automation, but that is not the same as running the product from an external CI pipeline. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD integration or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use telli's REST API to programmatically manage contacts, schedule calls, and integrate with your existing systems.
All endpoints authenticate with an API key from the telli app (Settings > Developer), sent as a bearer token
Download them to generate client libraries, import the API into tools like Postman, or give coding agents machine-readable API context
Workflows can now run automatically on a recurring schedule.
